findings.text: Selftest caps retained addresses at sixty four entries.

Timing accumulator holds minimum and maximum durations, saved and observed match counts, a perf marker, summed durations, a searched name pointer, a last matched address, plus a fixed address history sized by the selftest cap.
Expectation entry pairs a symbol name pointer with the expected numeric address for comparison.
Two table helpers stringify the given symbol for the name field; the function variant records the symbol value directly while the data variant records the address of the symbol.

Selftest provides static and global variables in both uninitialized and initialized storage, plus static, global and weak functions that bump counters when run; its table always checks the three local functions with vmalloc_noprof and vfree and adds the four data variables when full symbol mode is enabled.

A scratch name buffer sized by the symbol length limit is filled with a digit that cannot start a real name and truncated to the measured average length to force full-table misses; a counting callback sums name lengths across the table, then the ratio check walks the compressed name stream handling one and two byte length prefixes, subtracts length bytes, adds token table and index costs, and reports symbol count with compressed versus original sizes and percentage.

Name lookup timing wraps each resolution with a monotonic nanosecond clock, maintaining smallest and largest single durations with total and count; the driver clears state, seeds minimum to the largest integer, iterates every symbol through the callback, then logs total lookups with minimum, maximum and average cost.

Exact-match search compares each iterated name, counts hits, remembers the latest address, stores early hits up to the selftest cap, and requests early stop once the desired count is reached; the timing driver uses the synthetic miss name with an unbounded target to measure a complete traversal.

Filtered-match callback counts address notifications, remembers the latest address, stores early addresses up to the cap, and requests early stop at the target count; its timing driver measures a full traversal for the synthetic miss name.

Correctness check first requires direct lookup, full iteration and filtered iteration to each yield exactly one hit at the expected address for every fixed table entry; it then sweeps all symbol indexes, skipping non-kernel addresses, requiring reverse lookup to succeed, requiring direct lookup to return the first filtered address non-null, requiring at least one filtered hit, requiring sampled full iteration to agree with filtered iteration on final address, count and stored prefix, and requiring the originating address to appear among stored hits when the total fits the cap; mismatches log and fail with search error while allocation failure reports memory error.

Module init launches a dedicated thread pinned to CPU zero; the thread sleeps in five second intervals until the system reaches running state, runs the correctness check and aborts on failure, otherwise runs compression and the three timing measurements and logs start and finish markers.
Selftest header defines a single include guard macro to prevent multiple inclusion.
Kprobe logging uses a fixed subsystem prefix for formatted messages.
Probe hash width is six bits giving sixty four buckets.
Sysctl initialization for kprobes is an empty operation in this build configuration.
Kprobe core keeps an initialized flag, a fixed hash table with one list head per bucket, and a global flag indicating all probes are disarmed.
Optimization is gated by a boolean allow flag and a monotonically increasing pass counter records optimizer activity.
Probe control serializes on a dedicated mutex while the currently running probe for each CPU is held in a per-CPU pointer with set and clear helpers.
Weak name resolver returns the opcode address for a symbol name through the symbol lookup service, ignoring its second numeric argument.
Instruction page descriptor links into the cache list, points at executable slot storage and owning cache, tracks used and garbage counts, and carries a trailing per-slot state array.
Slots per page equal page size divided by the byte footprint of one slot.
Slot states are SLOT_CLEAN zero, SLOT_DIRTY one and SLOT_USED two.
Weak executable slot page allocator obtains memory close enough to kernel and module images for relative fixups, with a matching free wrapper.
Default instruction cache is initialized with its own mutex, the executable alloc and free hooks, a dedicated symbol tag, an empty page list, maximum instruction size and zero garbage.
Weak optimized-slot page hooks default to delegating to the regular instruction page allocator and free routine.
Optimized instruction cache mirrors the default cache with its own mutex, hooks, symbol tag, empty page list and zero garbage, leaving slot size for later initialization.

Slot allocation scans existing pages for a clean entry under cache mutex and read-side protection, marks the first clean entry used, repairs a corrupt used count with a warning, reclaims garbage and retries when full, otherwise allocates a new descriptor and executable page, links it for read-side traversal, announces it to perf, and returns the first slot, returning null when allocation fails.
Instruction slot caches require the owning cache mutex for allocation and freeing, read-side protection for page lookup and address tests, and a grace period before dirty slots are recycled.
Probe hash and aggregate lists are traversed under read-side protection with an assertion that the probe mutex state is considered, allowing lock-free readers during control operations.
Optimization passes require both the text mutex and CPU hotplug exclusion because stopping the machine consults online CPUs while hotplug also takes the text mutex.

A slot starts clean, becomes used on allocation, becomes dirty on deferred free or returns directly to clean on immediate free, then dirty entries return to clean after a grace period; a page whose usage drops to zero is released except that the final empty page is retained for reuse.

Page lookup derives a slot index from pointer distance divided by slot footprint, returning the owning page and index when within bounds and warning with a negative result when the address belongs to no page.

Slot release warns on double free, marks deferred entries dirty while counting per-page and cache garbage and collecting when garbage exceeds one page worth, otherwise reclaims immediately and may sleep during collection.
Address test reports true when the value lies within the page-sized executable range of any cached page, else false.
Probe lookup hashes the target address to a bucket and returns the first entry with identical address, otherwise null.
Aggregate detection checks for the shared aggregate pre-handler; an unused probe is an aggregate that is disabled and has no members.
Probe copy duplicates saved opcode bytes and architecture-specific instruction state from aggregate to member.
Optimized pre-dispatch walks aggregate members under read-side protection, invoking each enabled member handler with the per-CPU current probe set to that member and cleared afterwards.
Aggregate teardown removes both optimized and plain probe state then releases the enclosing optimized container.
Optimization readiness is true only for aggregates whose optimized instruction has been prepared, otherwise false.
One disarmed definition treats plain probes as disabled status and aggregates as disabled with no pending optimized members, while the alternate definition simplifies all cases to disabled status.
Queued state is true when an aggregate carries pending optimized members, otherwise false.

Optimized probe search scans backwards from the fault address within a bounded length excluding the breakpoint slot, skipping entries that lack prepared optimized state or are disarmed, and returns the first entry whose optimized range contains the address, otherwise null.
Optimizer delay constant is five.
Optimizer states are OPTIMIZER_ST_IDLE zero, OPTIMIZER_ST_KICKED one and OPTIMIZER_ST_FLUSHING two.
Optimizer core keeps a worker task pointer, a wait queue for kicks, an atomic state word, and a pass counter.
Optimize pass does nothing when all probes are disarmed, optimization is forbidden, or the pending list is empty, otherwise delegates the pending list to the architecture optimizer.

Unoptimize pass first returns optimized probes to plain state via the architecture helper, then clears the optimized flag, disarms entries that are disabled and still present, removes memberless disabled aggregates from the hash for later reclaim, and detaches remaining entries from the pending list.
Corrupt usage counts, double frees and lookups of unknown slots trigger warnings rather than silent corruption, indicating caller or accounting bugs.

Garbage collection can sleep and must observe a grace period before reuse; perf registration must follow page linkage and unregistration must precede unlinking; retaining one empty page avoids repeated setup teardown.
Taking the text mutex without CPU hotplug exclusion risks deadlock with hotplug and machine stop operations that also use both primitives.

Full-table cross validation samples a subset for the slower full iteration using a random stride averaging about one in one hundred twenty eight, so coverage is probabilistic rather than exhaustive for that comparison.
